Commentary.Commentary: This is it then! England have gone 1-0 in the ODI series and they lead the Super Series 10-8. Next, the two sides meet on 27th of August, 2016 at 1500 IST at Lord's. Until then, take care and goodbye!
Jason Roy has been awarded the Man of the Match for his brilliant knock of 65 off 56.

Pakistan were off the radar in their bowling as none of the bowlers looked threatening and didn't create any chances. Only Gul and Nawaz were successful with a wicket but were unable to create constant pressure. Pakistan's fielding was a mix bag as Sarfraz dropped a catch of Roy on 24 and on the other hand, Azhar Ali affected a superb run out of Root in the middle. Earlier, Pakistan lost track to score good target which they were looking at one stage when Azhar Ali and Sarfraz Ahmed were batting but had to settle for the 260-run mark. Credit goes to the English bowlers for bowling a good line and length in the death overs to restrict the tourists.

Joe Root and Eoin Morgan once again started scoring the runs where the former took the charge and the captain played second fiddle in the chase. Root too departed after his 15th ODI fifty. Morgan and Stokes then played sensibly at a good rate but just then rain halted the game. The play was resumed once again and the target was 252 in 48 overs.  The rain came in just after, when only 3 balls were bowled and England were declared as the winner by 44 runs via DLS method.

England have muscled Pakistan in this opener game with ease. Chasing a target of 261, the hosts started off in style with Jason Roy setting the tone for the run chase in Umar Gul's 1st over by hitting three fours. However, Gul did well to take the wicket of Alex Hales in his next over. In came Joe Root and he kept ticking the scoreboard with Jason Roy. Both the batsmen went on to stitch a stand of 89 runs between them before Roy was out after his fifty.
The match has been abandoned and ENGLAND HAVE WON BY 44 RUNS (DLS METHOD)
